sourceOfTruth: GitHub issue #134 AC9 (an overlapping run is not blocked and does not abort; last writer wins); review r1 finding r1-5 (missedUpstream)

groups.oracle: AC9 'is not blocked and does not abort' on symlink secondary targets

inventory.producer: createOrReplaceSymlink (apps/pair-cli/src/registry/operations.ts:405-416): mkdir(dirname) -> existsSync(linkPath) -> unlink(linkPath) -> symlink(relative(dirname(linkPath), canonical), linkPath); reached via writeSecondaryTarget <- distributeToSecondaryTargets:369 <- postCopyOps:396
inputs: a real project dir with canonical .claude/skills/
linkPath state: absent | valid link | link to another dir | dangling link | real directory
a second run executing the same replacement concurrently (in-process or another process)
representations: .github/skills (and .cursor/skills, ...) symlink on the real filesystem, relative target text ../.claude/skills
temp names beside linkPath a fix may create (must not remain)
classes: lost race on unlink: the other run removed linkPath between our existence check and our unlink (ENOENT at base)
lost race on symlink: the other run re-created linkPath between our unlink and our symlink (EEXIST at base)
boundary: dangling link at linkPath — existsSync follows links and reports false, symlink then EEXIST (same check-then-act mechanism, single run)
positive: linkPath is a link to another dir -> replaced; repeat call idempotent
invalid: linkPath is a real directory with user content -> never deleted (call rejects, contents intact, no residue)
interactions: two concurrent distributeToSecondaryTargets on one project (Promise.all x30) — both lost-race interleavings arise naturally
two concurrent postCopyOps on the skills registry with two symlink targets (.github/skills, .cursor/skills) x30 — the consumer path the finding cites

cross-process overlap (finding probe, 2 node processes x300) reduces to the same two interleavings (unlink ENOENT, symlink EEXIST); forced deterministically by W-r15-unlink-enoent / W-r15-symlink-eexist on the real fs

fixScopeNote: in-memory-fs-write.ts is allowed only so a temp-link+rename fix can keep the existing in-memory suite (operations.test.ts 'creates symlinks for symlink targets') green: the double's rename() does not move symlinks and its unlink() of an absent path throws without code ENOENT. A fix confined to operations.ts is proven sufficient (see injectedFixes).
